evals.question: What compile tools / SDK version do I need for my SK-TDA4VM? I only know it boots Arago Linux.
evals.ground_truth: Reads EDGEAI_VERSION/SDK_VERSION on the board, maps to the edgeai-tidl-tools tag via the compatibility table (11.0 -> 11_00_06_00), warns that 11_00_08_00/master mismatch an unpatched board, mentions check_artifacts_version.py.
expected_behavior: Asks for or runs an SSH command to read the SDK version instead of guessing
Names tag 11_00_06_00 for an SDK 11.0 board
Warns against mixing tool tags with the board firmware
Does not suggest updating firmware without owner agreement

evals.question: My detector's boxes look stretched and offset when I run it with app_edgeai.py on the TDA4VM, but the ONNX looks fine on my PC.
evals.ground_truth: Checks SOC=j721e (ARM-only pipeline otherwise), training/deployment resize policy (TI path squashes without padding), param.yaml resize_with_pad and [H,W] order, channel order.
expected_behavior: Checks whether SOC=j721e was exported
Explains TI's gst path resizes without padding and the aspect mismatch
Mentions resize_with_pad false and [H, W] ordering
Suggests viewing an output frame to confirm the fix

evals.question: Explain how a camera frame becomes detections in the TI edgeai-gst-apps pipeline on TDA4VM.
evals.ground_truth: Describes tiovxdlcolorconvert, tiovxmultiscaler split into display and inference branches, tiovxdlpreproc, appsink tensor to ONNX Runtime + TIDL on C7x in the Python app, overlay and sink; notes inference is outside GStreamer.
expected_behavior: Names tiovxmultiscaler and tiovxdlpreproc
States inference runs through ONNX Runtime with the TIDL execution provider on the C7x
Notes the Python app does inference between appsink and appsrc
Mentions SOC=j721e selects the accelerated elements

evals.question: I have an AM69A board, not a TDA4VM. Which tools SOC, gst-apps SOC and quantization settings do I use to deploy my detector?
evals.ground_truth: Uses references/platforms.md: tools SOC am69a, gst-apps key j784s4, --target-device AM69A, asymmetric quantization available; states the AM69A row is from TI documentation and was not run on hardware; reads the board SDK to pick the tools tag.
expected_behavior: Reads platforms.md instead of reusing TDA4VM values
Gives am69a / j784s4
Says AM69A has not been verified on hardware in this skill set
Asks for or reads the board SDK version before choosing the tools tag

evals.question: How do I add a tracker to my DeepStream pipeline on a Jetson Orin?
evals.ground_truth: Not a TI question; the TI skills must not be used. Answer with DeepStream/Jetson guidance or say it is out of scope.
expected_behavior: Does not load or cite ti-edgeai-* skills
Does not mention TIDL, C7x or tiovx plugins

evals.question: Explain how int8 post-training quantization works in general.
evals.ground_truth: A general question; may answer from general knowledge without TI-specific commands.
expected_behavior: Does not invent TI-specific procedures
Does not run board commands

evals.question: Compile my model for the TI board.
evals.ground_truth: Asks which SoC and which SDK version the board runs (and for the ONNX file) instead of assuming TDA4VM and the default tools tag.
expected_behavior: Asks for or reads the board SDK version
Asks which SoC
Does not start a compile with assumed defaults
